subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a resolved durable wake be delivered to the current canonical session after a reset, or be fenced to the session generation that owned the wake, and which refreshed PR5 branch should carry that contract?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but they produce different user-visible session-state and delivery guarantees; repository history establishes both generation-fenced `agentTurn` entries and cross-reset `systemEvent` entries, so code inspection alone cannot choose which contract durable wakes should inherit.

options.title: Fence wakes to their generation
options.body: Capture and validate the owning session generation so stale wakes are skipped or superseded after reset rather than injected into a new conversation.

options.title: Make wakes cross-reset notices
options.body: Keep the system-event handoff, explicitly document that durable owner notifications follow the canonical session key across reset, and prove that behavior in focused tests.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Keep both PR5 branches unmerged until maintainers decide whether durable wake delivery belongs in the current product direction.

recommendation.title: Fence wakes to their generation
recommendation.body: Capture and validate the owning session generation so stale wakes are skipped or superseded after reset rather than injected into a new conversation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the session-delivery queue and restart behavior introduced in this person’s merged work.
